qualification.details: No claim of an equivalent educational qualification other than what is advertised for a post will be entertained; RFCL's decision on admissibility of a qualification is final and binding. The essential qualification must be completed full-time and regular with a minimum of 60% marks, except for CA/CMA. Qualifications acquired through Part-Time/Correspondence/Distance Learning/Online/Evening Classes render the candidate ineligible. Candidates appearing in the final year/semester of the essential qualification, with results awaited as on the cut-off date, are NOT eligible to apply. Work experience for all posts must be after acquiring the relevant educational qualification, and must be in-line executive experience. Management Trainee/GET experience counts only if regularized in the same company. Apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961 does not count as post-qualification experience. Experience with candidates working on contract basis through empaneled agencies/contractors will not be considered. Candidates possessing higher technical/professional qualifications in the relevant field are also eligible, provided they possess the mandatory qualification listed above. Where CGPA/OGPA or a letter grade is awarded instead of a percentage, candidates must produce the University/Institute's official conversion formula; in its absence, a standard conversion table is used (e.g., 6.5 on a 10-point scale = 60%). Computer literacy is desirable for all candidates. Candidates employed in Central/State Government/Quasi-Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview, or submit an undertaking to produce a relieving order if selected - failing which they will not be allowed to join; no Service Transfer/Pay Protection will apply without an NOC at joining. Preference will be given to candidates with in-line executive experience in the Chemical and Fertilizer Industry. | Candidates from Government/PSU/Autonomous/Statutory Bodies/JVs with Pay Scales matching RFCL's scales should presently be working one level below the applicable pay scale for at least 1 year (E-1 posts) or 2 years (E-2 and above posts) immediately preceding the cut-off date, or be presently working in the same or higher pay scale on the cut-off date (see Annexure-A pay-scale correspondence table in the official notification). Candidates from the Private Sector, or from Government/PSU bodies whose pay scales do not match RFCL's, must provide proof of a minimum CTC as on the cut-off date, as detailed in the Salary section below.

salary_details.details: RFCL states it offers "one of the best pay packages in the Fertilizers Industry." The Pay Scales (2017 IDA-based) and approximate CTC per annum are as follows: | Besides Basic Pay, selected candidates will receive Industrial Dearness Allowance, other allowances at 35% of Basic Pay, Company Accommodation/House Rent Allowance (HRA not payable where Company accommodation is available), Leaves, Earned Leave Encashment, Medical Facilities, Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Defined Contribution Pension Scheme (DCPS), Performance Related Pay (PRP), and other welfare schemes as per Company rules. A Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) of 20% of Basic Pay is additionally payable to Addl. CMO/CMO (Medical).

how_to_apply: Eligible and interested candidates should apply online from 26 August 2026 (08:00 hrs) to 24 September 2026 (17:00 hrs) on the RFCL website: www.rfcl.co.in → Careers.
Only one application per candidate per post is allowed. Details can be edited before final submission, but cannot be changed once the online form is finally submitted - fill in carefully.
After successful online submission, take a printout of the application form.

Send the printed application, along with self-attested copies of all requisite supporting documents (educational qualifications, experience certificates, caste certificate, PwBD certificate, etc.), in a sealed envelope superscribed: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF …………………………… IN RFCL - 01/2026"
Post the sealed envelope to: Dy. General Manager (HR), Ramagundam Fertilizers and Chemicals Limited, Corporate Office, 4th Floor, Wing – A, Kribhco Bhawan, Sector-1, Noida, Uttar Pradesh – 201301
Ensure the hard copy reaches RFCL by 1 October 2026 (or 8 October 2026 for candidates from notified far-flung areas, with "FAR-FLUNG AREA" superscribed on the envelope).

Incomplete application forms, forms not supported by self-attested documents, forms not fulfilling eligibility criteria, forms received at any other RFCL address, or forms received after the due date will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: RFCL Recruitment Important Dates
content_sections.text: The cut-off date for determining eligibility with respect to age, minimum educational qualification, and experience is 31 July 2026 , and this will remain unchanged irrespective of any reason. Far-flung areas (for the extended hard-copy deadline) include Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim, Union Territory of Ladakh, Lahul & Spiti District and Pangi Sub-Division of Chamba District (Himachal Pradesh), Union Territory of Andaman & Nicobar Islands, and Lakshadweep. content_sections.heading: RFCL Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details (40 Posts)
content_sections.text: A total of 40 tentative vacancies are notified: UR-22, SC-05, ST-03, OBC(NCL)-07, EWS-03, with 04 posts reserved for PwBD candidates (applied horizontally within the above categories). Selected candidates may be posted at any Unit/Office of RFCL at any time, at the discretion of Management; only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply. Selected candidates will be required to work in general and/or rotating shifts, including night shifts, as per job requirement. The number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease at RFCL's discretion.

content_sections.heading: RFCL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications will be done based on the information and documents submitted; eligible candidates will be provisionally shortlisted and called for a Personal Interview . The shortlist will be placed on the RFCL website under "Careers." If a large number of applications are received, RFCL may conduct a Computer-Based Test in Delhi-NCR and/or other cities for shortlisting candidates for interview. No TA, or Boarding & Lodging, will be paid/arranged for appearing in this test. Test modalities, if conducted, will be published on the RFCL website. Candidates must qualify the Personal Interview with a minimum average of 50% marks . Tie-breaker for equal total marks: percentage of marks in the qualifying examination; if still equal, the candidate with the earlier date of birth is considered senior in the merit list. Candidates not meeting eligibility criteria, or without complete requisite documents, will not be allowed to attend the interview, and no TA will be paid. Travel Reimbursement for Interview: Candidates called for interview at level E-5 to E-8 are reimbursed single return air fare (economy class)/AC I rail fare/Executive class chair car/road mileage at prescribed rates. Candidates for E-1 to E-4 posts are reimbursed to-and-fro single AC II return rail fare from the nearest railway station of their correspondence address to the interview venue, by the shortest route, on production of documents/receipts. Candidature is provisional and subject to subsequent verification of Degree certificates/testimonials, Caste/PwBD/ExSM status. Candidature is liable to be rejected at any stage if the candidate does not meet the advertised eligibility criteria, irrespective of merit position. No candidate will be appointed unless medically examined, certified, and declared fit for employment by the Company's Medical Officer or a Medical Officer not below the rank of Civil Surgeon/CMO/Medical Superintendent of a State/Government Hospital.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RFCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible and interested candidates should apply online from 26 August 2026 (08:00 hrs) to 24 September 2026 (17:00 hrs) on the RFCL website: www.rfcl.co.in → Careers. Only one application per candidate per post is allowed. Details can be edited before final submission, but cannot be changed once the online form is finally submitted - fill in carefully. After successful online submission, take a printout of the application form. Send the printed application, along with self-attested copies of all requisite supporting documents (educational qualifications, experience certificates, caste certificate, PwBD certificate, etc.), in a sealed envelope superscribed: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF …………………………… IN RFCL - 01/2026" Post the sealed envelope to: Dy. General Manager (HR), Ramagundam Fertilizers and Chemicals Limited, Corporate Office, 4th Floor, Wing – A, Kribhco Bhawan, Sector-1, Noida, Uttar Pradesh – 201301 Ensure the hard copy reaches RFCL by 1 October 2026 (or 8 October 2026 for candidates from notified far-flung areas, with "FAR-FLUNG AREA" superscribed on the envelope). Incomplete application forms, forms not supported by self-attested documents, forms not fulfilling eligibility criteria, forms received at any other RFCL address, or forms received after the due date will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is RFCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification (Advertisement No. Rectt/01/2026) by Ramagundam Fertilizers and Chemicals Limited for the recruitment of experienced professionals across 40 posts in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Materials, Transportation, HR, Medical, Finance & Accounts, and IT disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RFCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 40 tentative vacancies are notified: UR (22), SC (5), ST (3), OBC-NCL (7), and EWS (3), with 4 posts reserved for PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RFCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window is open from 26 August 2026 (08:00 hrs) to 24 September 2026 (17:00 hrs). The hard copy of the application must reach RFCL by 1 October 2026 (8 October 2026 for candidates from far-flung areas).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for RFCL posts?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements are post-specific - ranging from a B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc.(Engg.) in the relevant engineering discipline to MBA, CA/CMA, or MBBS, along with post-qualification executive experience of 1 to 18 years depending on the post. Full details are listed in the Eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for RFCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age (UR category, as on the 31 July 2026 cut-off date) ranges from 30 years for Engineer/Officer (E-1) posts up to 50 years for Chief Manager (F&A, E-6), with age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen as per government norms, subject to an overall cap of 56 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for RFCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The non-refundable application fee is ₹1,000 for posts at E-5 and above, and ₹700 for posts from E-1 to E-4 (plus bank processing charges), payable online only. SC/ST/PwBD/ExSM/Departmental candidates are exempt from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for RFCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online at www.rfcl.co.in → Careers between 26 August and 24 September 2026, followed by sending a printed copy of the application with self-attested documents by post to the Dy. General Manager (HR) at RFCL's Corporate Office in Noida.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for RFCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through shortlisting of applications (with a possible Computer-Based Test if applications are very high in number), followed by a Personal Interview in which candidates must score a minimum average of 50% marks.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for RFCL posts?
faq.answer: Pay scales (2017 IDA-based) range from ₹40,000–1,40,000 (E-1, approx. ₹14.20 Lakhs CTC) to ₹90,000–2,40,000 (E-6, approx. ₹31.95 Lakhs CTC), plus Industrial DA, other allowances, HRA/accommodation, PF, gratuity, DCPS, and other benefits as per Company rules.
